name: What should you ask before hiring a floor-plan designer?

mainEntity.name: What questions reveal whether a custom floor-plan designer is right for a Los Angeles project?
mainEntity.text: What questions reveal whether a custom floor-plan designer is right for a Los Angeles project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a floor-plan designer, ask questions that reveal both design skill and process discipline. Key topics include local project experience, how they handle revisions, what deliverables are included, whether permit-ready drawings are part of the service, and how they coordinate with engineers or other consultants. You should also ask how they deal with zoning, setbacks, access issues, and other site constraints common in Los Angeles-area projects. The best designers can explain how they think, not just show past visuals. They should be able to describe how they turn your needs, lot conditions, and budget into a workable layout. Ask how often you will meet, how decisions are tracked, and what happens if the plan needs changes after concept approval. Clear answers signal a smoother project and lower risk of costly redesigns later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about local experience, revision limits, deliverables, timeline, consultant coordination, permit support, and how they handle zoning or site constraints. The answers show whether the designer can produce a usable plan or only a pretty concept.
